name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Fenwick's gold is exactly 20 gp more than the Illusion mage.
The adventurer with the Cat familiar's gold is higher than both the Half-Orc and the Evocation mage.
The Illusion mage's gold is between Wrenna and the Dragonborn.
The Human's gold is at least 30 gp away from the Enchantment mage.
Orin's gold is exactly 20 gp more than the Half-Orc.
Rat goes with exactly two of Fenwick, Illusion, and 48 gp.
The adventurer with the Wolf familiar's gold is immediately next to Fenwick.
